narrative.details:
My wife and I run an orphanage in Stormwind, mostly for children who have lost parents due to the attacks by the Scourge in the last decade. I come to Ironforge every month or so to see about collecting more supplies from the citizens here, and talk to the various groups to see if they can do anything to help.

This trip's been agonizingly slow, and not very productive.

If I could just get some more linen for my wife to make some clothes, I could finally send a shipment home.
narrative.objectives: Bring 10 Linen Cloth to John Turner in Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText:
This is so wonderful of you, adventurer. Thank you again.

You're a noble man for doing this for me. It's no wonder you've chosen to follow the Light. I wish there was some way I could repay you for all you've done... what's that? It's the least you could do? See? That's what I'm talking about, adventurer, noble to the end.

Be safe, and may the Light protect you in your travels.
narrative.requestItemsText:
What with the influx of tradesmen here and throughout Azeroth, there's a smaller supply of items we use to make clothes for the children of our orphanage. Helping me collect linen so my wife can make new clothes for them is very noble of you, adventurer. Thank you.

Hopefully, I'll be able to return home to my wife soon.
